title: Phone UI
description: A phone that rises in and shows an app screen: a real screenshot (scrolls gently) or a simple list built from params, followed by a tap on one item.

title.description: Heading above the main element. Trusted HTML: use word for the accent word.

appIcon.description: Path to the app icon (only a logo you may use). Empty shows an accent square.

screenshot.description: Path to a real app screenshot. When set, the drawn list is skipped.

items.description: [{title, subtitle, meta}] for the drawn list (3-5 items fit).

tapIndex.description: Index of the item that gets tapped (0-based); -1 for no tap.

lang.description: Language of the copy (BCP 47, e.g. en, tr, de). Sets <html lang>, which drives uppercase rules (tr: i -> İ).

duration.description: Scene length in seconds. new-scene.sh --params also rewrites data-duration to match.

checks: prefer a real screenshot for a real product
textcheck: title clear of the top UI zone
